newsitem.title: USA: Rutherford-Moran plugs Thai Gulf dry hole.
newsitem.headline: Rutherford-Moran plugs Thai Gulf dry hole.

text.p: Rutherford-Moran Oil Corp said on Tuesday that it had plugged its Benchamas 7 well in the Gulf of Thailand after coming across non-commercial hydrocarbon bearing zones in a new fault segment.
In addition, the company said drilling at its Benchamas 11 well had encountered 230 feet of net pay that was primarily oil.

"The success of this well extends the productive limits of the Benchamas Field as a whole and also confirmed the downdip limit of the fault segment," Rutherford president and chief executive Patrick Rutherford said in a statement.
In a third well in the same field, the Benchamas 13, the company said it found 410 net feet of primarily gas pay.
It added that the rig used to drill the three exploratory wells in the Benchamas Field had been moved to the Maliwan area, where it will drill two exploratory wells.
Rutherford-Moran Oil Corp is an energy company that concentrates its activities in Southeast Asia.
